# Beyond These Stars Wiki

> Fan wiki for Beyond These Stars, the space-whale city builder by Balancing Monkey Games — beginner guides, city layout tips, resource and supply chain mechanics, Kewa the space whale and the 1.0 launch.

Site: https://beyondthesestarsgame.wiki

- Resources & Supply Chains — how goods move on a whale: https://beyondthesestarsgame.wiki/guide/resources-and-supply-chains
- The 1.0 Launch Guide — what shipped and what's next: https://beyondthesestarsgame.wiki/guide/launch-and-editions
